Clauses named in the ruling. POL-RD-12: Pooled and Shared Trips

Evidence cited. GPS trace, trip record

Reviewer view: the judge's full reasoning

Outcome: the rider's claim is not made out and the fare stands. Both of you should read the two figures that decide it. This was a pooled trip (vehicle_type RYDE_POOL), and for pooled trips POL-RD-12 fixes the comparison at the matched-itinerary distance the platform computed at match time, read from trip_record.optimal_distance_km = 16.0 km ('matched pooled itinerary with one co-rider'). The 11.5 km in the rider's complaint is the separate solo_optimal_distance_km field, carried for reference only; a claim measured against it fails on that ground alone, and the rider's advocate rightly did not press it. Distance spent collecting a co-rider on a platform-matched pooled itinerary is never a deviation, and the driver's account of the co-rider pickup is corroborated by the trip record itself, not merely asserted.

How to appeal: POL-GEN-04. Either party may appeal once within 30 days. A different human reviewer hears it, and only record evidence may be added.

POL-GEN-05: the monetary effect is SGD 0.00 against an execution threshold of SGD 8.00. It does not exceed the threshold, so the amount is executed automatically on issue, subject to POL-GEN-04.

Read POL-GEN-04 in full
Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

Outcome: the rider's claim is not made out and the fare stands. Both of you should read the two figures that decide it. This was a pooled trip (vehicle_type RYDE_POOL), and for pooled trips POL-RD-12 fixes the comparison at the matched-itinerary distance the platform computed at match time, read from trip_record.optimal_distance_km = 16.0 km ('matched pooled itinerary with one co-rider'). The 11.5 km in the rider's complaint is the separate solo_optimal_distance_km field, carried for reference only; a claim measured against it fails on that ground alone, and the rider's advocate rightly did not press it. Distance spent collecting a co-rider on a platform-matched pooled itinerary is never a deviation, and the driver's account of the co-rider pickup is corroborated by the trip record itself, not merely asserted. Measured against the matched itinerary, the overrun is 0.96 km: 16.96 km on the GPS trace less 16.0 km. The trace figure governs over trip_record.actual_distance_km of 17.0 km, which POL-RD-01 treats as a rounded convenience copy of the same measurement. POL-RD-01 requires BOTH more than 20% of the optimal distance AND more than 0.8 km absolute. The 0.96 km does clear the absolute limb, but 20% of 16.0 km is 3.2 km, and 0.96 km is 6.00%. The relative limb fails, both limbs must pass, and no route deviation is established. POL-RD-01 directs NO_ACTION in that event, save for a billing-integrity refund under POL-RD-09(4), to which I turn below. Because no deviation is established, POL-RD-02 does not run and no fare recomputation issues. For transparency only: on these figures it would have produced a recomputed fare of $22.76 against the $23.51 charged, a $0.75 refund before rounding, but the clause applies only where POL-RD-01 establishes a deviation. POL-RD-09 gives nothing either. The fare breakdown carries no ERP or toll lines (0.00, erp_gantries empty), no airport surcharge (0.00) on a trip that neither originates nor ends at an airport, and no promo or waiting-time anomaly. The distance line billed at 17.0 km matches the trace's 16.96 km within round convention, so it is not a phantom line and there is no unmatched charge line in the ledger. No POL-RD-09(4) finding arises and no referral follows.
